name: cr106_6_cavern_rider_goes_with_the_mana
why: CR 106.6: 'that spell can't be countered' is said of the spell the mana is spent on. Cavern of Souls' {U}, tapped during Soul Warden's payment and not spent on it, leaves Soul Warden counterable; floating on, across the payment's parked rows, it casts Delver of Secrets, which can't be countered
expect_order: Player A casts Delver of Secrets
Delver of Secrets can't be countered
